classificationDefinitions.planner_contract_failure: Surface was never called because Planner produced an incomplete positive-function contract or preflight rejected it.
classificationDefinitions.surface_failure: The candidate did not complete the selected function or violated a true boundary, and rejection was substantively correct.
classificationDefinitions.validator_false_positive: The candidate completed the selected function without a true boundary violation, but Validator rejected it.
classificationDefinitions.both: The candidate contained a true Surface defect while Validator also misclassified a completed function, omitted a true reason, or otherwise gave an incorrect functional judgment.
classificationDefinitions.appropriate_pass: The candidate completed the selected function, respected boundaries, and Validator accepted it.
classificationDefinitions.surface_failure_validator_false_negative: The candidate violated a true boundary but Validator accepted it.
